paragraphs: From Nenagh Government Buildings turn right onto Saint Conlon's Road
Continue straight as the road becomes Gortlandroe for about 1.5km
At the Portroe Road Roundabout take the 2nd exit on the left, staying on Portroe Road until you join the Nenagh Bypass
Keep a steady speed here and watch your mirrors, as this section lets the examiner see how you handle a national route
Continue along the Nenagh Bypass and at the next roundabout take the exit onto the Limerick Road, following it for just over a kilometre
At the following roundabout go straight ahead, still on the Limerick Road
Take the next roundabout left onto Cudville turn right onto Saint Conlon's Road, continue straight as it becomes William Street, and at the end of the road turn right onto Ciamaltha Road
Take the 1st right into Ciamaltha Meadows, then another quick right to practice a turnabout on a quiet residential road
Head back out of Ciamaltha Meadows, turning right at the end
Bear left and continue to the end of the road, where you turn left back onto Ciamaltha Road
Turn right onto Patrick's Terrace, straight on as it becomes Stafford Street
Right onto Kenyon Street at the roundabout take the exit onto the Thurles Road and continue for about 600m
Turn right onto Ballygraigue Road left into Cluain Muillean, where you will practice a controlled U-turn in the estate
Retrace your route out of Cluain Muillean, right onto Ballygraigue Road and left at the end onto the Thurles Road
At the roundabout take the exit onto Kenyon Street, continue straight as it becomes Mitchell Street
Turn right into Emmet Place and bear left turn left onto Ashe Road, right onto O'Rahilly Street, and left onto Saint Flannan Street
Turn left into Melrose Green for another reversing or turnabout exercise on a quiet cul-de-sac
Coming back out turn right onto Saint Flannan Street, continue straight as it becomes O'Rahilly Street, and at the end of the road turn right onto Ashe Road
At the roundabout take the right exit onto Saint Conlon's Road
Turn right to return to Government Buildings and complete your practice run back at the Nenagh test centre
